name: Beef Borsch with Sour Cream
description: A hearty beet-based soup with shredded beef, vegetables, and a dollop of sour cream on top.
recipeIngredient: 2 Tbsp snipped fresh dill or 2 tsp dried dill weed

recipeInstructions.text: Day before serving, place beef, marrow bone, 2 quarts water, and 1 Tbsp salt in a deep 8-quart kettle. Cover and bring to boiling, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Add tomatoes, quartered onion, celery, parsley, black pepper, and bay leaf. Simmer, covered, for 2 hours longer.
Remove from heat. Lift out beef and set aside. Remove marrow bone and discard. Strain soup and skim off fat (you should have 9 cups liquid).

Return soup and beef to kettle. Add beets, cabbage, carrots, chopped onion, dill, vinegar, sugar, and 1 tsp salt. Bring to boiling, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until beef and vegetables are tender.
Cool for 20 minutes, then refrigerate overnight.
The next day, remove beef from soup and cut into cubes. Return to soup and heat gently to boiling.
Pour into soup tureen. Top each serving with a spoonful of sour cream and garnish with snipped dill.

keywords: beef borsch, sour cream, beet soup, Eastern European soup

_similar.name: Beef & Barley Soup
_similar.description: A hearty beef and barley soup with vegetables and tomato, ideal for freezing and reheating.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked roast beef (or 2-3 cups chopped hamburg meat)
½ cup pearl or pot barley

recipeInstructions.text: Heat water and bouillon cubes in a large pot, stirring until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients except beef and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1½ hours.
Add beef and simmer for an additional ½ hour.

_similar.name: Minestrone Soup with Shells
_similar.description: A hearty minestrone soup with small shell macaroni, kidney beans, and vegetables, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ cup (175 mL) small shell macaroni
1 can (14 oz/398 mL) red or white kidney beans, drained
3 cans (10 oz/284 mL each) chicken broth
1 can (19 oz/540 mL) tomatoes, coarsely chopped with liquid

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, cook the chopped bacon until crisp. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and cabbage; cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes.
Stir in the water, chicken broth, and tomatoes with their liquid. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Stir in the small shell macaroni and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes longer.
Add the kidney beans, garlic, and parsley to the soup; heat through.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

_similar.keywords: minestrone soup, pasta soup, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

_similar.name: Tortilla Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.
